BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY EDITORIAL TEAM

Portugal has released 30,000 sterile male mosquitoes in Lisbon as part of a push to bring down populations of the Asian tiger mosquito (Aedes albopictus), a species that can carry dengue, Zika, and yellow fever. Last Thursday’s release in Alvalade was the third and final deployment of this phase. Sixty thousand sterile mosquitoes have now gone out across Portugal in total.

Male mosquitoes don’t bite; only females do, and the sole reason they do is to get blood for egg development. Males exist to mate

Actual Article Body:
Rather than being stuck on the chain gang, California prisoners are often on the bucket brigade.

Roughly half of all California firefighters are incarcerated individuals. The pay is better than other prison jobs, and is reported to be a welcome break from the monotony of prison life.

Now, following the stewarded passage of a bill that’s been signed into law by Governor Gavin Newsom, formerly incarcerated firefighters will reenter society with a direct career pipeline.
